primary_text:
🌀 Movement brings blessings – the rotating mantra bracelet with Tibetan energy! ✨

The handmade Tibetan silver bracelet with rotating prayer wheel pendant and six sacred syllables combines spiritual symbolism with urban street style – for men and women. 🕉️🌟

🌟 Your powerful statement:
✅ Rotating cylinder pendant with traditional “Om Mani Padme Hum” engravings.
✅ High-quality sterling silver (925) with a matte antique finish.
✅ Practical magnetic clasp for easy putting on and taking off.
✅ One size fits all with adjustable cord (7.5–8.7 inch wrist circumference).
✅ Comes with an explanation of the six syllables and a storage pouch.

From meditation to a stroll through the city – wear your energy on your wrist! 🧘‍♂️🌆
👍We offer a 30-day unconditional money-back guarantee.
